title: Website motion system
thesis: Mez website motion is restrained component behaviour, not a channel spectacle. Static is complete. Motion may make one product material feel alive, clarify a direct interface change, reveal nearby content, or explain a short process. It stays brief, local, interruptible and subordinate to the page hierarchy.

decisionModel.selectionRule: Prefer the nearest user-caused component response. Otherwise allocate motion only to the single most visible eligible product material or demonstration. Repeated and secondary content remains still.

roles.title: Focal material
roles.job: Make one approved product field feel alive while its chassis, Wings and content stay fixed.
roles.duration: continuous only while selected and visible

roles.title: Functional response
roles.job: Confirm a direct action or spatial change without calling attention to animation itself.
roles.fallback: immediate final state with equivalent hierarchy

roles.title: Simple demonstration
roles.job: Show one short input-to-result sequence when a single still cannot explain the mechanism.
roles.fallback: complete before-and-after state with visible reading order

families.title: Motion Laws
families.job: Approve the three reasons website motion may exist.

families.title: Website Components
families.job: Define the smallest approved component behaviours needed before individual production components are built.

reducedMotion.runtime: Do not initialise the Living Core renderer; use the exact static product material.
reducedMotion.functional: Apply the resulting state immediately while preserving focus and content order.
reducedMotion.demonstration: Show the complete before-and-after state without automatic playback.
reducedMotion.components: Remove travel and stagger; retain visibility, selection, focus and progress meaning.

exportContract.equivalence: Every animated component is a progressive enhancement over a complete static or immediate-state interface.
exportContract.sourcePaletteAuthority: Exact source-derived product colour remains authoritative and Wings geometry never animates.

prohibited: motion production for email, ads, organic social or film inside this repository task
animated Wings geometry or logo morphing
scroll hijacking, pinned storytelling or forced scrub sequences
pulsing, breathing, spinning, bouncing or floating product objects
staggered animation on every page section
motion-dependent content, navigation or conversion actions
automatic carousels that move before user intent
manual animate buttons on product material
automatic motion that ignores reduced-motion preference

deferral.reason: A real global navigation needs its own visual, semantic, responsive, accessibility and packaging contract; the Round 03 illustrative menu is not promoted as a component.
deferral.boundary: The website-motion system constrains the future component, but does not approve its anatomy or visual direction.
